mu_name_from: NPC/SnowMerchant01.bmd, loaded as MODEL_SNOW_MERCHANT (ZzzOpenData.cpp:1874). ZzzCharacter.cpp's MONSTER_CAREN_THE_BARMAID arm names her the Korean for 'tavern madam'; OpenMU's Version075 calls her Caren the Barmaid and gives her Lumen's store. Type 244, standing once in Devias at 226,25.
why_this_one: Devias's barmaid is Lorencia's barmaid made into one file. Lumen is four pieces on Female01's rig; Caren is the same three magic_shop sheets on a single .bmd with her own two clips, which is the smith's shape rather than the merchants'. The sheets are byte for byte the ones Lumen's pieces already wear, so nothing new is decoded for her.
sheet_from: Out of Data/NPC, beside the model. Data/NPC/magic_shop*.OZ? decode to the same pixels as the pngs Lumen's pieces use, so those are reused rather than copied under a second name.
sheet_materials_from: Lumen's own choices, sheet for sheet (source/npc/body/Female*.json): her face and her dress share magic_shop01b, so the page takes skin.
cutout_from: As on FemaleUpper01: the .OZT carries a real alpha channel, the frill at her shoulders.
